member.name: M:JetBrains.Debugger.Tools.ProcessEnumerator.Core.ProcessInfoUtil.GetDotNetProcessesFromDiagnosticPipes_Windows
member.summary:
This method quickly enumerates possible .NET processes using a debug pipeline workaround: almost any process that have some kind of .NET runtime enabled will open a debug pipe named "dotnet-diagnostic-[pid]". This is known to work on Windows.
It is okay if this method returns an empty set: processes will then be enumerated using orthodox methods.
